Garam Masala is a specialty of North India. Sprayed in tiny quantities at the end of cooking, it includes a highly fragrant and slightly hot fragrance to energy up the dish. It can also be utilized as a flavor enhancer to dishes that require a little taste and kick.

Garam masala is a captivating spice blend that hails from the vibrant culinary traditions of North India. This fragrant and slightly piquant seasoning is a true delight for the senses. Sprinkled in small quantities towards the end of cooking, garam masala infuses dishes with a warm, aromatic flavour that energises the palate. Its complex blend of spices, including cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and cumin, adds depth and richness to curries, stews, and rice preparations. Ramdev Premium Garam Masala is a premium quality spice that can also be used as a flavour enhancer, elevating the taste and experience of your favourite Indian dishes.
